units.source_text: 藤壶皇后受的刺激太深，肝火上升，头脑充血，越来越痛苦了。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo had been too deeply shaken; her anger flared, blood rushed to her head, and her suffering grew worse and worse.

units.source_text: 她的哥哥兵部卿亲王及中宫大夫等前来视疾，立刻吩咐召请僧众举行法事，一时纷忙骚扰。

en.t: Her elder brother, the Prince Minister of War, the Steward of the Empress's Household, and others came to see how she was, and at once ordered monks to be summoned for rites, throwing everything into sudden bustle and confusion.

units.source_text: 源氏大将躲在壁橱里静听外间情状，心中只是叫苦。

en.t: General Genji hid in the closet and listened silently to what was happening outside, inwardly lamenting his misery.

units.source_text: 到了日暮时分，藤壶皇后好容易渐渐苏醒。

en.t: By dusk, Empress Fujitsubo at last gradually came back to herself.

units.source_text: 她想不到源氏大将躲在壁橱内。

en.t: She had no idea that General Genji was hiding inside the closet.

units.source_text: 侍女们防她懊恼，也不把此事告诉她。

en.t: Fearing that it would distress her, the ladies-in-waiting did not tell her about it either.

units.source_text: 她觉得身体好些，便膝行到白昼的御座上来坐地。

en.t: When she felt somewhat better, she moved forward on her knees to the daytime seat of honor and sat down there.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王等看见她已复健，便各自归去，室中人少了。

en.t: Seeing that she had recovered, the Prince Minister of War and the others each took their leave, and the room grew less crowded.

units.source_text: 在平日，皇后近身的侍女也不多，别的侍女都退避在各处隔障物后面。

en.t: Even on ordinary days, few ladies-in-waiting attended closely on the Empress, and the others all withdrew behind the various screens and partitions.

units.source_text: 王命妇便和弁君悄悄地商量办法：“怎样打发公子出去呢？

en.t: Lady Omyobu quietly discussed a plan with Ben no Kimi: "How can we get the young lord out of here?

units.source_text: 如果留他在此，今夜娘娘再发作起来，可不得了！”

en.t: If we leave him here and Her Majesty has another attack tonight, it will be disastrous!"
